description: Imports (deserializes) a Sitecore user or role from the CM's filesystem, overwriting the account's current state with the serialized one. The .user / .role file must exist — export it first with security-export-account. On SitecoreAI prefer Sitecore CLI serialization.

accountType.description: Whether the identity names a user or a role.

identity.description: The account to import, e.g. 'sitecore\admin' or 'sitecore\Author'.

path.description: Exact server-side .user / .role file to deserialize. Not with root.

root.description: Server-side directory to deserialize from. Defaults to Sitecore's serialization folder. Not with path.

name: security-import-account
